title: A note on the fridge
model: Cambridge A1 Movers / A2 Key – Reading Part 1 (short messages)
text:
Hi Sam,
I'm at work until seven o'clock today, so I can't cook lunch. There is some soup in the fridge. You can eat it with bread. Please don't eat the chocolate cake! It's for Maria's birthday party tomorrow.
Can you go to the supermarket this afternoon? We need milk, eggs, tomatoes and some apples. The money is in the blue box on the kitchen table. The supermarket closes at eight, but it is very busy after six, so please go early.
Tonight I want to cook pasta for dinner. Your friend Tom can come too, if you want. Dinner is at half past eight.
Oh, and the cat is hungry all the time, but she only eats twice a day: in the morning and in the evening. Please don't give her more food!
See you later,
Anna

questions.prompt: Why did Anna write this note?
options: To ask Sam to do some jobs at home
To invite Sam to a birthday party
To tell Sam about a new recipe
To say she is going on holiday

questions.prompt: What must Sam not eat? (1–3 words)
Where is the money for the shopping?
options: In a box on the kitchen table

questions.prompt: In the note, the word 'busy' (paragraph 2) means:
Complete: For dinner tonight, Anna wants to make ___.
What do we learn about the cat?
options: It asks for more food than it should eat

title: Sunrise Gym – new opening hours
text:
SUNRISE GYM – NEW OPENING HOURS
From Monday 3rd March, the gym has new opening hours.
Monday to Friday: 6 am to 10 pm
Saturday: 8 am to 8 pm
Sunday: 9 am to 2 pm
The swimming pool opens one hour later and closes one hour earlier every day.
Yoga classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at 7 pm. They are free for members. Other people pay five pounds a class. Please bring your own mat.
Children under 14 can use the pool only with an adult. They cannot use the gym machines.
There are lockers in the changing rooms. They cost one pound, and you get your coin back at the end. Please do not leave bags on the floor.
The café on the first floor sells drinks, sandwiches and fresh fruit. It is open from 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.
Questions? Ask at reception or call 0161 555 0198.

title: A new pen friend
text:
Hello Lucas,
My name is Mei and I'm your new pen friend. I'm twenty-two years old and I live in Taipei, in Taiwan. I'm a student at the university here. I study music, and I play the piano and the guitar.
I live in a small flat with my older sister. She is a nurse and she works at night, so I often eat dinner alone. My parents live in a village near the sea. I visit them every month.
In my free time I like cooking and taking photos of the city. On Sundays I go to the night market with my friends. The food there is cheap and very good!
I want to learn English because I want to study in Canada next year. My English is not very good, but I practise every day.
What about you? Do you have any brothers or sisters? What do you do at the weekend?
Write soon!
Mei

title: Lost cat
text:
LOST CAT – PLEASE HELP!
Our cat, Biscuit, is lost. We last saw him on Tuesday evening in Park Street, near the post office.
Biscuit is two years old. He is orange with a white face and white feet. He has a green collar with a small bell. He is very friendly, but he is afraid of dogs and loud noises, so he may hide in gardens or under cars.
Biscuit is not well. He needs to take medicine every day, so we are very worried about him.
If you see him, please don't try to catch him. Call us and we can come quickly. Please also look in your garage or garden shed. Maybe he is inside!
There is a reward of fifty euros for anyone who finds him.
Phone: Emma or Jack – 0612 334 908
Thank you very much!

title: School trip to the science museum
text:
Dear parents,
On Friday 14th May, Class 4B is going on a trip to the Science Museum in the city centre.
We are leaving school by bus at 8:30 am, so children must arrive at school at 8:15. We are coming back at 3:30 pm.
The trip costs eight euros. This pays for the bus and the museum ticket. Please give the money to Mrs Clark before Wednesday.
Children need to bring a packed lunch and a bottle of water. Please don't send fizzy drinks or sweets. There is no shop in the museum.
The weather may be cold, so children should wear warm clothes and comfortable shoes. We are walking a lot!
Please sign the form below and return it with the money.
Thank you,
Mr Patel
Class teacher, 4B

title: A message from Mum
text:
Hi darling,
Good news! Dad and I can visit you this weekend. We are taking the train on Saturday morning and we arrive at your station at 11:20. Can you meet us there?
We want to see your new flat and meet your flatmates. Don't worry, we don't need to sleep at your place. We have a room in a small hotel near the river for two nights.
On Saturday afternoon, Dad wants to go to the football stadium. You know he loves football! I want to go shopping in the old town. Maybe you can come with me?
On Sunday, let's have lunch together. You choose the restaurant, but please not a very expensive one!
We go back home on Monday morning, so we have lots of time.
I'm so happy to see you soon.
Love,
Mum

title: City Library rules
text:
WELCOME TO THE CITY LIBRARY
Please read our rules.
You can take out up to six books at a time. You can keep them for three weeks. If you want more time, you can renew them online or at the front desk.
If you bring a book back late, you pay twenty cents for every day.
Please speak quietly. Phone calls are not allowed in the reading rooms. You can use your phone in the entrance hall.
You can drink water in the library, but please do not eat. There is a small café on the ground floor.
The computers are free for members. You can use them for one hour a day. Please book a computer at the front desk.
Children under ten must be with an adult.
OPENING TIMES: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm. Closed on Sundays.

title: Welcome to Hotel Marina
text:
WELCOME TO HOTEL MARINA
We hope you enjoy your stay with us!
Breakfast is in the restaurant on the ground floor, from 7 to 10 am. On Saturdays and Sundays, breakfast finishes at 11.
The swimming pool is on the roof. It is open from 9 am to 8 pm. Towels are next to the pool, so you don't need to take the towels from your room.
The wifi password is MARINA2024. It is free in all rooms.

title: A postcard from the mountains
text:
Dear Grandma,
Hello from the mountains! We are staying in a small wooden house near a lake. It's very quiet here and the air is clean.
The weather is cold in the morning, but in the afternoon it's sunny and warm. Yesterday we walked to the top of a hill. It took three hours! My legs hurt now, but the view was beautiful. We saw some goats and a big bird.
In the evenings we play cards and Dad cooks dinner. His food is not very good, but don't tell him!
There is no internet here, so I can't send you photos. I'm writing this postcard in the kitchen next to the fire.
We are going home on Friday. I want to visit you on Sunday and tell you everything.
Lots of love,
Noah
